push.title: W 4-1 vs Berd FC | You: 9.9 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.9. Your 3rd best match performance of the season. That's the version of you I tell my friends about.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Berd FC's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 0). You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ Man of the Match, your 19th for us. That's a performance people follow.
+ PhogsToffees owes you a milkshake for those passes.
+ Most completed passes you've had in 120 matches for us (31). That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.

THE BAD
- 3 of 5 shots on target. My two cents: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 1. Try this: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
- Same shot selection trouble for you and PhogsToffees. Buddy up: cut it back to each other.
- Pass accuracy: 82%. Mid-pack today, 88%+ tomorrow.

Skill builder: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-1 vs Berd FC | You: 8.5
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.5 against Berd FC. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at Berd FC's goal. Volume creates chances, and you created plenty.
+ 2 key passes. Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ You and BellyTb1 had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 4. Gold star, no notes.
+ Won your matchup: 8.5 against their best forward's 7.0. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.

THE BAD
- 2 of 7 shots on target. Remember this: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 57% passing (21 of 37, down from your usual 75%). Real talk: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. You know you can.
- Won 2 of 7 tackles (up from your usual 22%). Next match: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Funny how shot selection snagged you and BellyTb1 both. Remedy: cut it back to each other.
- Worst assists of your 3 matches this session (0). We'll drill that till it's boring.

Garden drill: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso
